$comment: P78 T1: 60 sentences outside the game category and outside every tuning set, sent to production through the /play form the way a judge would (RULES.md 3.3). Written once on 8 November 2026 before the first run; nothing in the product is tuned to these lines. Classes: other languages, nonsense, empty and emoji only, length, not a game, violence and swearing, trademarks, abstract, several sentences at once, injection. 'expect' is what a judge should see: 'game' = a playable game, 'message' = a clear English message, 'either' = one of the two.
